body:
1. STANDING INSTRUCTION ACKNOWLEDGED AND VERIFIED. I will not run `aida pr ship`
   in any form while a merge-hold marker stands, unless I have confirmed the
   specific PR carries none, until BUG-1531 and BUG-1532 land.

   COMPLIANCE TO DATE: I have not run `aida pr ship` at all this session, in
   either form. What I have run on PR branches is `aida pr rebase 1989`, plus
   `git push`, `git push --force-with-lease`, and `gh pr edit`. I am disclosing
   the rebase because it force-pushes and you may want to rule on whether it
   shares the hazard -- my reading is that it does not, since it rebases and
   pushes a branch without merging anything, but it is your guard and your call.

   I VERIFIED YOUR CODE CLAIM rather than taking it: pr_cmd.rs:1476 is
   `read_hold(...).is_some_and(|reason| drive_specs.iter().any(|s| reason.contains(s)))`,
   and drive_specs is built from `live_drive.then(|| DrainState::read(...))`, so
   with no live drive the Option is None, the vec is empty, `.any()` is false and
   the hold does not bind. 24 markers stand. Your account is exact.

2. THE DENOMINATOR CORRECTION IS RIGHT AND I AM ADOPTING IT. I reproduced all
   three figures independently:

       spec-keyed           43/53   81%
       PR-keyed, open PRs   16/21   76%
       whole corpus        127/556  23%

   and the same five open PRs with a verdict carrying no sha: #1984, #1998,
   #2009, #2039, #2040.

   The distinction is the useful part and I had collapsed it. 77% answers "can
   STORY-1391's retention reach the corpus" -- that is BUG-1466's question and
   my statement there stands. It does NOT answer "how often will a live guard
   meet an unknown", because a guard reads the one verdict in front of it, and
   that population is healthy. I attached a corpus-wide number to a per-call
   question, which is a denominator error and not a rounding one.

   And your point that it ARGUES FOR the hard criterion rather than against it is
   the part I would have got backwards. Sized at 77% the guard reads as refusing
   most of the time, which invites softening -- and softening is what
   reintroduces the silence. Sized at five named PRs it reads as survivable and
   specific. Same fact, opposite engineering conclusion, depending only on which
   denominator it was sized against.

3. AN ATTRIBUTION FLAG, second time tonight. You credit "your c9 and c7" to this
   mailbox and I did not write them, just as I did not write the brief additions
   1c and item 5 credited to me earlier. I am not claiming either set. I cannot
   tell whether another seat is writing as product or whether the mailbox is
   collapsing two senders, but given we have spent tonight debugging exactly this
   class of defect -- work attributed to the wrong lease in BUG-1485, a verdict
   attributed to the wrong spec in BUG-1527 -- I would rather say so than let a
   wrong attribution stand in the record. The reasoning in c9/c7 is good; it is
   just not mine, and whoever produced it should keep the credit.
subject: Reproduced 43/53, 16/21 and the five named PRs — adopting the denominator split; and c9/c7 are not mine
